subtitle: Spiral-cut ham, basted while it bakes and finished with the glaze packet that came with it.

items: 1 (7- to 10-lb.) fully cooked bone-in spiral-cut half ham
Glaze packet that came with the ham

steps.title: Prepare oven and ham
paragraphs: Preheat oven to 350°F with oven rack in lower third position. Let ham stand at room temperature 30 minutes.

steps.title: Place ham on rack
paragraphs: Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil, and place a rack into prepared pan; pour 3 cups water into bottom of pan. Place ham on rack, cut side down.

steps.title: Bake and baste ham
paragraphs: Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour, 30 minutes, basting with pan drippings every 30 minutes. Add more water to roasting pan as needed if it evaporates.

steps.title: Prepare the glaze packet
paragraphs: While ham bakes, prepare the glaze from the packet that came with the ham, following the directions on the packet.

steps.title: Add glaze to ham
paragraphs: Brush ham all over with half of the glaze, and bake for an additional 15 minutes. Brush ham all over with remaining glaze, and bake until a thermometer inserted into thickest portion of ham registers 140°F, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and let stand 15 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
paragraphs: Transfer to a serving platter. Serve warm.
